title: Test timing reporter
goal: Per-file start, finish and wall time, naming files a killed run never finished
acceptance: `core/tools/test-timing-reporter.mjs` is a Node test reporter that prints per-file wall time and lists files that started and never finished; the quiet reporter stays the default
Output is a stable line format the F-105 flaky-test column can read (documented, not wired here)
Fixtures: a passing file, a slow file, a file killed mid-run
Failing test committed first: the killed-file fixture expects the file listed as unfinished against an empty reporter; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 2 h; the reporter is small, the fixtures are the cost. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
